ICS: Greets the patient/family member and introduces self and team
Explains the purpose of the meeting (“*we’re here to review your situation and figure out the best way to take care of you going forward*”)
Asks the patient/family to describe their understanding of patient’s health
Describes the current medical condition succinctly without jargon
Offers an opportunity for the patient, family member to ask questions
Assumes a comfortable inter-personal communication distance
Allows patient and family time to reflect-does not rush discussion; uses silence
Recognizes and responds to emotion verbally
Displays empathy through words and expressions (active listening, repeating/paraphrasing, touch, facial expressions) at appropriate times
Do you believe the physician is able to present bad news with compassion in a manner so as to do no harm?
